The Plateau State Police Command has begun an investigation into a fire incident that claimed the lives of a newly married couple, Sikiru Habib and his wife, Ramlat Lawan, in Anguwan Miyango, Bukuru, Jos South Local Government Area of the state. The couple reportedly died from injuries sustained after a fire engulfed their residence at about 2:30am on Saturday while they were asleep. Confirming the incident, the spokesman for the state police command, SP Alabo Alfred, said the matter had been reported to the police, and an investigation had commenced to establish the cause of the fire. “Yes, it is actually a fire incident. The incident has been reported to us, and we are investigating the cause of the fire incident,” Alfred said when contacted. Residents of the community, who confirmed the incident to journalists in Jos on Monday, described it as tragic, saying the couple became trapped inside their room as the fire spread. The groom died on Sunday, while the bride died on Monday after both were admitted to hospital,” Suleiman said. He said the situation became more dangerous when the room’s door reportedly failed to open, leaving the couple trapped inside. Suleiman said the victims were subsequently rushed to the Jos University Teaching Hospital, where they received medical attention. “Despite efforts to save their lives, the couple died,” he said. He added that their deaths had thrown their families, relatives, friends and residents of Anguwan Miyango into mourning, particularly as the tragedy occurred shortly after their marriage.
